description: Zone réglementée du PPRT " SERVICE NATIONAL des OLEODUCS INTERALLIES (SNOI)" sur la commune de Port-de-Bouc- Bouches-du-Rhône is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. For PPRTs, the environmental code defines a single category of zones for zones (L515-15 et seq.): areas at risk. Unlike natural RPPs, PPRTs never have restricted areas that are not directly exposed to risk. Depending on the hazard level, each TRPP area is subject to an enforceable settlement. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Simple download service (Atom) of the dataset: Restricted area of the PPRT “NATIONAL SERVICE des OLEODUCS INTERALLIES (S" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2022-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
